name: @md-prettify/vscode-extension
author: DrBoria <dr.boria@gmail.com>
description: VS Code adapter for md-prettify — thin IDE layer over the IDE-agnostic backend.

scripts.test: tsc -p ./ && for f in out/apps/backend/test/extension-host-adapter.test.js out/apps/backend/test/extension-grammar-discovery.test.js out/apps/backend/test/extension-activation.test.js out/apps/backend/test/extension-api-message-flow.test.js; do ../../node_modules/.bin/mocha -u tdd --timeout 30000 "$f" || exit 1; done
